Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 74: September 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #74 shipped to subscribers in August 2007 (bearing the cover date of September 2007 for Issue 74). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #74 landed right at the peak of the late-summer blockbuster surge, featuring high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and extensive video coverage:

BioShock (sci-fi immersive sim / first-person shooter)
Skate (physics-driven street skateboarding simulation)
Stuntman: Ignition (Hollywood stunt driving action)
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 08 (golf simulation)
Marathon Durandal (Xbox Live Arcade sci-fi FPS classic remaster)
Spyglass Boardgames (Xbox Live Arcade classic board games suite)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard themes, downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including post-E3 2007 media features for Halo 3, Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Mass Effect, and Fallout 3, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
